caption:
Slow follow-up has a dollar amount attached to it.

The Revenue Calculator finds it in four inputs: monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and average response time.

It hands back your revenue per lead, a modeled monthly follow-up gap, and three separate annual upside scenarios if you tighten any one of those numbers.

Response time is one of the few levers you control.

rationale: 2026 benchmarks still favor carousels for depth, but single-offer promo images remain the fastest-converting format for one clear ask, and the Revenue Calculator is next in this cycle's tool rotation after the Ad ROI Calculator.
